}}, better known as '''B Dup''', is a major [[antagonist]] in {{SA}}.

He is voiced by rapper [[The Game]].

==History==
===Background===
B Dup used to be a loyal member to the [[Grove Street Families]] but began to move away from the gang and into dealing drugs. Dup begins to sell drugs in [[Los Santos (3D Universe)|Los Santos]], including to [[Big Bear|Barry "Big Bear" Thorne]], whom he exploits into being his personal slave. B Dup has Bear clean his [[B Dup's Apartment|home]] in [[Ganton]]. B Dup is also later heard on [[West Coast Talk Radio (3D Universe)|West Coast Talk Radio]], saying "the problem in the hood is that there isn't enough drugs in the hood".

===Events of ''Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas''===
====Recruitment Attempt====
[[Carl Johnson]] and [[Ryder]] attempt to recruit B Dup during the mission [[Cleaning the Hood]] to kill some [[Ballas (3D Universe)|Ballas]] drug dealers. B Dup declines their offer as the Ballas are responsible for bringing the drugs into the city which he does not want to fight against, and is more concerned with making profit by selling them.

====Defeat====
Much later in the game, during the mission [[Beat Down on B Dup]], Carl and [[Sweet]] visit B Dup in his [[B Dup's Crack Palace|new home]] in [[Glen Park]], [[Kilo Tray Ballas]] territory. After Carl and Sweet retake Glen Park, they enter B Dup's house to face him. B Dup then orders Big Bear to chase them off, but Big Bear could not take any more abuse or drugs from B Dup so he punches B Dup and leaves with Carl and Sweet. B Dup is never seen or mentioned again after that encounter, though it is likely that he is still alive.

B Dup works for [[Big Smoke]] as he refers to him as "the boss" during the mission Beat Down on B Dup. It is likely that Big Smoke supplies him with drugs.

==Character==
===Appearance===
B Dup wears a khaki cap and wears a black Ballas jacket over a white shirt, black pants and white tennis shoes.

==Trivia==
*B Dup's name is a play on the words "beat up".
*His outfit resembles that worn by the members of N.W.A in the early [[1990|'90s]]. His jacket is a chore coat and is purchasable in [[Victim]] for $320.
*His chore coat has a [[Rockstar]] logo on it.
*B Dup's jacket looks like the jacket that the [[Ballas2|second member of the Ballas]] wears.
